name: Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash
label: Quest
description: In Dun Morogh, Tundra MacGrann needs his winter stores back from Old Icebeard. The injured hunter cannot reach the yeti's cave himself.

clips.title: The story
paras: In Dun Morogh, Tundra MacGrann needs his winter stores back from Old Icebeard. The injured hunter cannot reach the yeti's cave himself.

Tundra MacGrann had salted away a month's worth of dried meat for the cold season. He lives beyond the warmth of Kharanos and Ironforge, where surviving winter takes careful preparation. To keep hungry bears from his provisions, he locked them in a thorium-reinforced meat chest. Old Icebeard carried the whole chest away rather than trying to open it.

Old Icebeard stole the chest while MacGrann was away hunting deer and dragged it to a cave in the jagged hills. MacGrann believes the yeti cannot break through solid thorium, but his injured leg keeps him from retrieving the stores. Anyone entering the cave must face the beast or slip inside while it prowls the snowdrifts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I had a month's worth of dried meats salted and locked away for the cold season. Kept it locked so the bears wouldn't get it! But while I was off hunting deer, that beast, Old Icebeard, made off with the meat locker. He won't be able to smash through that Thorium though. But I'll starve if I can't get my meats back.
You seem a bit more stealthy than me. Perhaps you can retrieve my stash? I'll never make it in and out of that cave fast enough with this bum leg of mine.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Were you able to get into my meat locker, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: What a kind soul you are, friend! Thanks to your bravery I won't find myself starving when the cold season flurries blow in.
